meta.title: WispOps — fleet server operations
meta.description: Manage many servers from DeepSeek Harness: inventory and groups, fleet health inspection with trends, disk-full diagnosis, and fleet commands over OpenSSH. Change, sudo and destructive actions follow per-host policy, time-boxed /ops-allow grants, or a one-shot approval; sudo passwords come from the WispTerm Password Store and never reach the model.
